401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

templateName.description: Name of the template to render. The template must already exist in Docmosis.

outputName.description: Filename for the rendered document output. The extension can imply the format when Output Format is omitted.

data.description: Structured JSON data merged into the template.

streamResultInResponse.description: When true, base64-encodes the streamed result into the JSON response body.

outputFormat.description: Optional output format. Valid options are PDF, DOCX, ODT, or TXT.

storeTo.description: Optional destination for the rendered output such as stream, mailto, or s3. Defaults to streaming the result back.

requestId.description: Optional caller-provided identifier echoed back in the response.

tags.description: Semicolon-separated tags to record against this render for later reporting.

devMode.description: If set to y, yes, or true, render in development mode instead of failing hard on template/data issues.

availablePct.description: Approximate queue availability percentage reported by Docmosis.

rejected.description: Whether the Docmosis queue rejected the render request.

resultFile.description: Base64-encoded rendered document when Stream Result In Response is true.
